---

version: alpha
name: Libraries.dev
description: A high-craft UI library showcase for AI-driven development, featuring dark-themed effect playgrounds with sophisticated motion and elevation.
colors:
  bg: "#121212"
  text: "#ffffff"
  text-muted: "rgba(202, 202, 202, 0.7)"
  card-bg: "#181818"
  card-border: "rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06)"
  accent: "#55cfff"
  pro-blue: "#0071fc"
  pro-tint-bg: "rgba(0, 113, 252, 0.18)"
  stage-bg: "#131313"
  skeleton: "rgba(238, 238, 239, 0.1)"
typography:
  font-sans: "'Inter', -apple-system, sans-serif"
  font-display: "'Saans', sans-serif"
  font-mono: "'Roboto Mono', monospace"
  size-hero: "42px"
  size-title: "36px"
  size-body: "16px"
  size-small: "13px"
spacing:
  app-gutter: "24px"
  card-gap: "24px"
  section-margin: "96px"
rounded:
  card: "24px"
  surface: "12px"
  pill: "50px"
  inner-stage: "14px"
components:
  nav-pill:
    height: "36px"
    bg: "rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)"
    radius: "{rounded.pill}"
    text: "{typography.size-small}"
  lib-card:
    bg: "{colors.card-bg}"
    radius: "{rounded.card}"
    shadow: "0 1px 3px 0 rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04)"
  hero-badge:
    bg: "#181818"
    border: "rgba(196, 196, 196, 0.05)"
  skill-btn-primary:
    bg: "#ffffff"
    color: "#0d0d0d"

---
